name: Corsico (Italy)
description: Red field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Corsico (a red cross on white, crowned, within olive and oak branches).
history: Municipal flag of Corsico, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Corsico arms — a red cross on white, crowned, within olive and oak branches
